title: Legend in the Making
description: Nobody below him would fight a Champion candidate honestly, and there is nobody above him. Vorn has not fought a real bout in six years. He will not enjoy losing, and he will hand the title over anyway.

objectives.description: Take the Champion's title from him

notes: Rank: Elite -> Champion (final promotion). Boss fight against Vorn at full power. Non-lethal but extremely challenging. Champion Circlet grants +5 to all combat stats. Vorn's Battleaxe is unique legendary weapon. Unlocks repeatable bounty board. Max guild rank achieved. Threat/stake: Vorn's own standing as combat authority, and every waiting Elite passed over by the winner. Giver motive: Vorn is the only one who can test a Champion candidate honestly. Consequence stated in prose (Guild's best contracts go to the new Champion); not wired since this is a single boss fight with no branch.
